## Context / Problem
A measured bug class: validation implemented in one CLI command while the MCP/library/reconciler paths skip it — the engine-vs-interface placement decision is made silently at plan time and never reviewed.

## Approach
Add project criterion project.engine-layer-enforcement to the plan-review registry (via .rebar/criteria_routing.json overlay + criterion definition): ADVISORY posture; deterministic trigger = plan file_impact/scope touching src/rebar/_commands/ or interface modules while naming validation/guard/check work; the reviewer asks where the invariant is enforced and flags CLI-only placement, suggesting the engine seam. Advisory (not blocking) because placement can be legitimately interface-local; the criterion teaches, the census (skill-side) enumerates.

## Scope
- criteria registry/routing overlay + generated criteria guide regeneration
- criterion detection detail per docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md conventions

## Testing
Behavioral eval per LLM-surface conventions (pinned config, repeated trials): plan placing validation in CLI-only -> advisory finding fires; plan placing it in engine with CLI delegating -> no finding. Registry round-trip: rebar explain project.engine-layer-enforcement renders.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Criterion registered, routed by the deterministic trigger, ADVISORY posture, with detection detail in the generated guide.
- [x] Eval demonstrates fire/no-fire on the two plan shapes above.
- [x] rebar explain <id> serves the criterion.
